B5-X-U7-Q040.text: Cryptosecurity is the protection that results from the proper use of cryptographic systems

Proper cryptosecurity demands that we never bypass operational guidance of cryptographic systems and never reveal to an unauthorized person any information about our equipment such as type, configurations, operational status, etc

B5-X-U7-Q041.text: TRANSEC results from all measures designed to protect intentional transmissions from interception and exploitation by means other than cryptanalysis
TRANSEC protects information by making us choose the right (secured) system for our communications needs, but it cannot protect against the enemy’s cryptanalysis efforts

B5-X-U7-Q042.text: With the physical security vulnerabilities in mind, we physically protect against vulnerabilities by creating physical barriers and limiting COMSEC access to only essential and properly cleared personnel
